text: a neighbouring harness credited its design phase ending at round three to a precommit guard that refuses finding-shaped rows it cannot parse. The guard judges the shape of rows that exist; it cannot require a round to file one. The counter-evidence sits in the same repository: another spec ran thirteen design rounds under the same hook and filed zero design-round rows, so the guard had nothing to refuse. Third instance today of a control credited with governing what it only touches next to
